title: Figure 16: Negative Refraction With "Bulk" Optical Metamaterials Made of Nanowires
description: Multi-panel figure. Panel A is a rendering of an Al2O3/Ag nanowire metamaterial block with a light beam refracting through it at angle θ, plus two electron-microscope insets of the nanowire array. Panels B and C show color intensity maps for TM and TE polarization at θ = 0° and 30° at λ = 660 nm and 780 nm. Panel D plots refraction angle against incident angle (-30° to 30°) for TM and TE modes. The caption reads "Figure 16. Demonstration of Negative Refraction With 'Bulk' Optical Metamaterials Made of Nanowires."
